channel.title: The Chef's Cut
channel.description: The Chef’s Cut focuses on the stories and techniques behind the food you love the most!  Each week, Top Chef alums Adrienne Cheatham and Joe Flamm give you behind the scenes kitchen access and share food tips that will make you look like a culinary hero, all while hanging out with their celebrity chef friends and making you laugh a lot. If you’re a foodie, there’s a good chance The Chef’s Cut will be the highlight of your week!  New episodes drop every Tuesday.
